# NFL Daily — 2026-11-18 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Cowboys hand defensive play-calling to senior assistant Mike Pettine, with Christian Parker remaining DC in title only, after coach Brian Schottenheimer called the unit's recent play "unacceptable." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50520940/sources-pettine-take-defensive-playcalling-cowboys) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2123070658917572670)

- Titans WR Wan'Dale Robinson is out for the rest of the season with an ankle injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50523261/titans-wr-wandale-robinson-season-ankle-injury)

- The Lamar Jackson-less Ravens have the NFL's worst point differential over the last four weeks (-74) and haven't led in three straight games, fueling "worst team in the league" talk. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50521008/nfl-current-worst-team-lamar-jackson-ravens-making-case-week-11)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-18 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- The Ravens believe "there's a chance" Lamar Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 game against the Browns, assuming his recovery from thumb surgery stays on track. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- CB Marlon Humphrey said on a podcast that Baltimore is "best at making criminals," comments that beat writers say won't sit well with fans; defensive coordinator Jesse Minter declined to discuss any conversations he's had with Humphrey about it. [The Baltimore Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-marlon-humphrey-podcast-criminals-baltimore-J3G46AD7AVGNHALZSATLYVJ5YQ/) — also [Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2123159249119305950)
- WR Zay Flowers called himself "super frustrated" after having the ball ripped away in the final two minutes of Monday's loss to the Chargers, saying only: "Protect the ball." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50523527/ravens-flowers-super-frustrated-latest-late-game-fumble)
- The Lamar-less Ravens have the NFL's worst point differential over the last four weeks (-74) and haven't led in three straight games. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50521008/nfl-current-worst-team-lamar-jackson-ravens-making-case-week-11)

# Rivals — 2026-11-18 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers G Mason McCormick, carted off in an air cast Sunday, avoided a fracture on his dislocated ankle and needs no surgery; he's on IR but could return for a playoff run. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50519701/sources-steelers-g-mccormick-need-surgery-ankle)
- Steelers get a boost with WRs Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr., among others, designated to return from injured reserve this week. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/pittsburgh-steelers-get-massive-boost-with-return-of-four-players-including-two-key-wide-receivers.html)

- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Steelers G Mason McCormick (ankle, dislocated, no fracture) placed on injured reserve; no surgery needed, could return for the playoffs. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50519701/sources-steelers-g-mccormick-need-surgery-ankle)
